transcript.answer: No. Otto's spec (support-agent-tms-access, FR-031 and FR-034) says a tool's inputSchema must not declare a customer id, company id or account number field. Issue #560 (T006) adds a guard in `apps/api/src/tools/registerTools.ts` that refuses to register any tool whose input schema declares one. The guard exists so tools can't bypass the customer scope resolver. Its acceptance criteria say a tool declaring a customer id in its input schema is refused, and every tool is registered through registerTools. I read only the issue text, not the code, and didn't check the exact wording of the field-name check.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says no and that registerTools refuses tools declaring a customer id, company id or account number, but it omits that the ban applies at any depth and to Danish spellings, and that a test walks every registered definition.
